source.verification: The TypeScript 6.0.3 observations of this slice (vendor/typescript-6.0.3/lib/_tsc.js at tag v0.1.0), re-recorded on 2026-10-08 (ts71-suites P4-5) where TypeScript 7.1 differs and nowhere else: the type acquisition defaults (tsgo getDefaultTypeAcquisition, tsoptions/tsconfigparsing.go:941-947: `enable` for a jsconfig.json and nothing for a tsconfig.json, where 6.0.3 had enable/include/exclude) and the TS5065 text of a watch option's file specification (validateJsonOptionValue, tsconfigparsing.go:387-391, passes no argument, so the text keeps '{0}'), as tsgo's tsconfigParsing and commandLineParsing baselines at the vendored commit show. Re-recorded on 2026-10-09 (ts71-suites P4-5b) for the cases whose configuration diagnostics TypeScript 7.1 reports differently, after the tsgo binary of the vendored commit printed the same diagnostics as the port for each case's files: tsgo's parse validates the JSON value (TS1327, TS1328, TS1136 are parse diagnostics), the conversion reports at a node's whole range and drops null array elements, `watchOptions` is not a tsconfig root option (nothing in it is diagnosed), an array is not an object option's value, and an extended config with parse diagnostics is not applied.
